title: Ubuntu Snap Store API Structure
description: JSON structure documentation for the Snap Store API key entities.

Snap.description: A snap package available in the Canonical Snap Store.

fields.name: string — Package name in kebab-case
fields.title: string — Display title
fields.publisher: object — Publisher name, username, and ID
fields.channels: object — Release channels with revision and version info

Channel.description: A snap release channel (stable, candidate, beta, edge).

Category.description: A category grouping in the Snap Store.
